Laura / Jillian —

We reviewed Redwood’s v2 redlines. Key commercial / risk items to flag up front:

1) Data handling scope: recommend clarifying the exact telemetry and log categories Redwood will retain and retention durations (we propose 90 days for debug logs, 12 months for aggregated usage metrics).
2) Indemnity cap: suggest negotiating a mutual cap aligned to order-form ARR.
3) Service credits: request clearer SLO definitions tied to credits; customers prefer numerical targets rather than 'best efforts'.

We will prepare a consolidated redline PDF and a one-page memo that calls out anything we think needs exec-level discussion. Expect to send both by 7/08 COB.

Team —

I reviewed the latest MSA redlines and drafted a 1-page summary of the open risk buckets: data retention, indemnity, and SLO/credits (see bullets below). I also pulled together the evidence links to attach for Acme (SOC 2 report excerpt + retention policy).

Open items (short):
- Data retention: propose we offer 90-day debug logs / 12-month aggregated metrics; allow customer-controlled retention via config on Dedicated deployments.
- Indemnity: propose a mutual cap = 12 months of fees or $1M (whichever is greater) — flexible for enterprise deals but flag to finance.
- SLOs: propose specific P99 latency target and a 5% monthly credit for sustained miss beyond thresholds.

Evidence links: https://drive.google.com/example/SOC2-excerpt, https://drive.google.com/example/retention-policy

I will attach the one-pager to the consolidated MSA response.

Neha
